title: A House for the Visitor
author: Lior Kavanagh
blurb: Mirabel Sandoval, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, documents everything, because documentation is a kind of prayer. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the harvest moon rises.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
